    • vars

      public TemplateResolver.Builder vars(Var... values)
      Registers additional vars. None are registered by default except the internal scope var.
      Parameters:
      values - The vars. Must not be null. A var named P replaces the scope var, which rebinds the ${name} shortcut.
      Returns:
      This object.

      This object.

    • allowFunctions

      public TemplateResolver.Builder allowFunctions(String... patterns)
      Adds function-name globs to the default allowlist (SafeFunctions.patterns()).

      Repeated calls are additive. A bare * is rejected because it would switch default-deny off; use allowOnlyFunctions(String...) to replace the defaults.

      Parameters:
      patterns - The patterns. Must not be null, and must not be *.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If a pattern is *.

    • allowOnlyFunctions

      public TemplateResolver.Builder allowOnlyFunctions(String... patterns)
      Replaces the default function allowlist (SafeFunctions.patterns()) with exactly these globs.

      Include $op.* to keep the operators. Patterns from allowFunctions(String...) are still added. A bare * is rejected.

      Parameters:
      patterns - The patterns. Must not be null, and must not be *.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If a pattern is *.

    • strict

      public TemplateResolver.Builder strict(boolean value)
      Enables strict mode: an unknown or denied function, or an expression error, throws instead of being emitted as written.

      value - Whether to enable strict mode.

    • structureRenderer

      public TemplateResolver.Builder structureRenderer(StructureRenderer value)
      Sets how lists, blocks and tables are rendered. Overrides the renderer of destination(Destination).

      Without a renderer Structure.toString() is used, and its items are not encoded.

      Parameters:
      value - The renderer. null clears it.
      Returns:
      This object.
